name: New Kosmos
source:
New Kosmos follows the mission of two cosmonauts entrusted with a experimental task which may be humanity's last hope upon its own downfall. 

A dreamy atmosphere all alone in space seems so nice, doesn't it? Yet you can't shake that feeling. Why would anything be wrong, though. The state wouldn't do that to you. The state needs you. 

Now, brush away those thoughts, it's time to start a new day. You have the whole universe at your fingertips!

[From [url=https://27sunday.itch.io/new-kosmos]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《新宇宙》讲述了两名宇航员的使命，他们被委托执行一项实验任务，这可能是人类垮台后的最后希望。

独自一人在太空中，梦幻般的氛围似乎很美好，不是吗？但你无法摆脱这种感觉。但为什么会有什么问题呢。国家不会这样对你。国家需要你。

现在，抛开这些想法，是时候开始新的一天了。整个宇宙都触手可及！

[来自[url=https://27sunday.itch.io/new-kosmos]itch.io[/url]]
